messages:
elaine: Heads-up — discovered a replay/duplicate creation bug in the onboarding sampleapp when the Node SDK retries on 429s with our current jitter. Repro steps: fast client retry + token refresh race yields duplicate DB rows.

raj: Ugh. Is this because we don't require an idempotency key at the sampleapp layer?

elaine: Exactly. Sample app was using naive retries. We rely on the app for idempotency but onboarding template doesn't set one. Also Node SDK used 'equal jitter' default which made correlated retry timing under load.

sam: For parity — Python SDK default does a small client-side idempotency header for create endpoints (Idempotency-Key). Node's README doesn't mention it.

linda: Can we change sampleapp to set an Idempotency-Key by default for POST /create-user? Even a UUID per request would reduce duplicates. Also we should surface guidance in the quickstart.

elaine: Proposed patch: add header generation in sampleapp and a safety check server-side to dedupe by idempotency key for 60s. Also PR will flip Node SDK retry jitter to "full jitter" for 429s. Draft snippet: 

```js
// client request example in sampleapp
const idempotency = crypto.randomUUID();
const res = await client.post('/v1/onboard', user, { headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': idempotency } });
```

raj: Full jitter + server-side dedupe sounds good. But watch out for token rotation — if the SDK refreshes token during an inflight request, we still might replay a request to a downstream that isn't idempotent. Need to ensure the SDK marks retries as safe-replay only when idempotency key exists or request is known-idempotent.

sam: Agree. We should add a retry classifier: only auto-retry POSTs if header present OR request is idempotent verb (GET/PUT with idempotency semantics). Fallback: expose an opt-in flag like { safeReplay: true } in SDK to be explicit.

linda: Test plan: add e2e that spawns 200 concurrent onboarding requests, force 429 on first try for a subset, assert no duplicate users created. Add unit test for token refresh race where refresh happens between attempt and retry.

elaine: I'll open PR with sampleapp change + CHANGELOG entry. Draft title: "sampleapp: set Idempotency-Key + safer retry defaults for Node SDK". Tagging deploy-bot: @deploy-bot can you run the canary tests once PR is up? :pray:

deploy-bot: CI triggered for PR #4237 — running canary pipeline (unit, e2e, flaky-check).

raj: One more thought — update docs/devex/retry.md with recommended backoff pseudocode and example:

```text
// full jitter per AWS Best Practices
base = 100ms
cap = 2000ms
retry_n = Math.min(cap, base * 2 ** attempts)
delay = Math.random() * retry_n
```

sam: Also add note about streaming endpoints: we can't safely replay streaming requests; mark streaming API as non-replayable and require application-level resume tokens.

elaine: Good catch. I'll add a short note in the quickstart and a link to "streaming-resume" pattern.

linda: Thanks — once PR passes CI, let's roll into an opt-in patch release for the sampleapp and update the SDK changelog. :shipit:

sam: Nice — thanks for catching, elaine. This would have been nastier in production.

elaine: Yup. Lesson: conservative retry defaults + explicit idempotency keys are a DX win.
